name: USGS Earthquake Catalog (FDSN Event)
summary: Real-time and historical global earthquake catalog with GeoJSON, CSV and QuakeML output.
description: The ANSS Comprehensive Earthquake Catalog queried via the FDSN event web service: origin time, magnitude, depth, location, felt reports, tsunami flag, alert level and more. Also available as pre-built real-time GeoJSON feeds (past hour, day, week, month).

rate_limit.summary: No formal rate limit; max 20,000 events per query. Heavy users should use the static feeds.

endpoints.summary: Count events matching the same filters as /query
Static real-time feed of the past day

coverage.temporal: Catalog reaches back to the 1900s; comprehensive from about 1970

agent_notes: Timestamps are epoch milliseconds. Without time filters the query returns the last 30 days, so always set starttime/endtime for history. For frequent polling prefer the static summary feeds.
caveats: Maximum 20,000 events per query; page with offset/limit or narrow the time window.
